simple.meaning: עָשָׂר (ʻâsâr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen ; also (ordinal) -teenth.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 338 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 5:8. Its contexts include family, family line, death, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשָׂר (H6240).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H6240. asar or esreh עָשָׂר 203 , עֶשְׂרֵה 144 noun ten , only after units to make numbers 11-19, both cardinal and ordinal; עֶשְׂרֵה with noun feminine , עָשָׂר with noun masculine , thus: 1 eleven: a. עָשָׂר אַחַד (with masculine noun) Gen 32:23 2 t. b. עֶשְׂרֵה אַחַת (with feminine noun) 2Kin 23:36 7 t.; also = eleventh 1Kin 6:38 ; 2Kin 9:29 . c. עָשָׂר עַשְׁתֵּי (with masculine noun) Num 29:20 ; ordinal Deut 1:3 7 t. d. עֶשְׂרֵה עַשְׁתֵּי (with feminine noun) Exod 26:7 4 t.; ordinal Jer 1:3-4 t. 2 twelve: a. עָשָׂר (ם) שְׁנֵי (with masculine noun) Gen 35:22 80t. ordinal 1Kin 19:19 12 t. b. עֶשְׂרֵה שְׁתֵּי(ם) (with feminine noun) Exod 24:4 31t.; ordinal 2Kin 8:25 6 t. 3 thirteen: a. עָשָׂר שְׁלשָׁה (with masculine noun) Num 29:14 2 t.; ordinal Est 3:12 7 t. b. עֶשְׂרֵה שְׁלשׁ (with feminine noun) 1Kin 7:1 9 t.; ordinal Gen 14:4 2 t. 4 fourteen: a. עָשָׂר אַרְכָּעָה Gen 46:22 13 t.; ordinal Exod 12:6 17 t. b. עֶשְׂרֵה אַרְבַּע Gen 31:41 5 t.; ordinal 2Kin 18:13 3 t. 5 fifteen: a. עָשָׂר חֲמִשָּׁה Hosea 3:2-3 t.; ordinal Exod 16:1 14 t. b. עָשָׂר חֲמֵשֶׁת Judg 8:10 ; 2Sam 19:18 . c. עֶשְׂרֵה חֲמֵשׁ 2Kin 14:17 9 t.; ordinal 14:23 ; 2Chr 15:10 . — See also עֶשֶׂר 2d. 6. sixteen: a. עָשָׂר שִׁשָּׁה Exod 26:25 6 t.; ordinal 1Chr 24:14 2 t. b. עֶשְׂרֵה שֵׁשׁ Gen 46:18 13 t. 7 seventeen: a. עָשָׂר שִׁבְעָה 1Chr 7:11 2 t.; ordinal Gen 7:11 3 t. b. עֶשְׂרֵה שְׁבַע Gen 37:2 4 t.; ordinal 1Kin 22:52 ; 2Kin 16:1 . — See also עֶשֶׂר 3d. 8. eighteen: a. עָשָׂר (שְׂמֹנַת) שְׁמֹנָה Gen 14:4 10 t.; ordinal 1Chr 24:15 ; 25:25 . b. עֶשְׂרֵה שְׁמֹנֶה Judg 3:14 6 t.; ordinal 1Kin 15:1 8 t. 9 nineteen: a. עָשָׂר תִּשְׁעָה 2Sam 2:30 ; ordinal 1Chr 24:16 ; 25:26 . b. עֶשְׂרֵה תְּשַׁע Gen 11:25 ; Josh 19:38 ; ordinal 2Kin 25:8 = Jer 52:12 . These numbers usually take singular of the nouns most often used, חֹדֶשׁ יוֺם, שָׁנָה, , compare (sometimes) אַמָּךְ אִישׁ, , etc.; otherwise plural; rarely (late usage) they follow noun, which is then usually plural, e.g. Num 29:30 ; Josh 15:51 (P), Ezra 8:35 (twice in verse); Est 3:13 ; 8:5 , etc. (even עֶשְׂרֵה שְׁתֵּים שָׁנִים Nah 5:14 ), but שָׁנָה precedes ordinal 1Kin 6:38 , שְׁנַת 15:1 8 t., so יוֺם (c. ordinal) 2Chr 29:17 5 t. Esther 9; also יוֺם and שָׁנָה (שְׁנַת) both precede and following ordinal Num 7:72 , 78 ; 2Kin 8:25 ; 9:29 ; 14:23 ; 16:1 ; Jer 32:1 ; 2Kin 25:8 = Jer 52:12 . — See also Kö ii. 1. 211 ff. Da Synt. § 37 a , also R. 1, 2. Ges §§ 92d, e , 134, and especially Herner Synt. d. Zahlw-rter im AT {1893} ; on form in הֵ֯ (prob for יַ֯ ), Ol § 110 Kö ii. 1, 427 W SG 138 .
